title: Recorder Equals Generic Row Stream
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, Boolean input word $y$, and natural number $n$, the generic stream of the first $n$ rows whose fields are the binary representations of the movement counts of $M$ on $y$ equals the recorder's serialized trajectory prefix of $n$ rows.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every source machine, virtual input $y$, and count $n$, the generic row stream of the binary movement counts at each time equals the recorder's serialized trajectory prefix of $n$ rows.
